apiError.description: SUMMARY only: true when USPTO Patent Public Search could not be read (at all, or mid-stream). See the ERROR record.
apiError.title: Source error

applicationNumber.description: PATENT only: the USPTO application (serial) number as published, e.g. "18/751240".
applicationNumber.title: Application number

assignee.description: PATENT only: the recorded assignee exactly as published in the official register (usually an organisation; occasionally a person for independent filings). Where a publication records no assignee — common for the newest applications — this is the recorded applicant instead. Register data — no contact details ever.
assignee.title: Assignee

cpcCodes.description: PATENT only: the publication's inventive CPC (Cooperative Patent Classification) symbols as indexed, e.g. ["G06N20/00"].
cpcCodes.title: CPC classifications

datelessSkipped.description: SUMMARY only: results skipped because the index carried no usable publication date for them — a windowed run cannot place them.
datelessSkipped.title: Skipped (no publication date)

deliveredNew.description: SUMMARY only: how many PATENT records this run delivered (and charged).
deliveredNew.title: Delivered

duplicatesSkipped.description: SUMMARY only: results skipped because the monitor store had already seen them, or because a search repeated one within the run.
duplicatesSkipped.title: Duplicates skipped

durationSec.description: SUMMARY only: the run's duration in seconds.
durationSec.title: Duration (seconds)

errorCount.description: SUMMARY only: how many errors the run recorded (see the ERROR record / summary errors).
errorCount.title: Error count

familyId.description: PATENT only: USPTO's current family identifier for the publication (a stable numeric ID, shipped as a string).
familyId.title: Family ID

filingDate.description: PATENT only: the application filing date (ISO date). Null when none is indexed.
filingDate.title: Filing date

filteredOutDate.description: SUMMARY only: results excluded because their publication date fell outside the run window (the window is enforced on the record itself, boundary-inclusive).
filteredOutDate.title: Filtered out (outside window)

generatedAt.description: SUMMARY only: when the run produced this summary (ISO 8601, UTC).
generatedAt.title: Generated at

inventors.description: PATENT only: a one-entry list with the first-listed inventor's name exactly as published in the official register, in "First Last" order. A publication can name more inventors; the USPTO search payload returns the first. Register data — no contact details ever.
inventors.title: Inventors (first-listed)

itemsErrored.description: SUMMARY only: patents that matched but failed at delivery/charge time.
itemsErrored.title: Items errored

kindCode.description: PATENT only: the WIPO kind-code suffix of the publication number (e.g. "B1", "B2", "A1"), exactly as published — kind-code meanings are office-specific, so the raw code is shipped without an invented label.
kindCode.title: Kind code

matchedQueries.description: PATENT only, keyword runs only: the run's keyword query that surfaced this patent. A patent found by several of the run's queries is delivered — and charged — once, and this field names the first query that found it.
matchedQueries.title: Matched keyword queries

matchedTotal.description: SUMMARY only: how many publications USPTO reported for the run's searches inside the window (summed per search), before per-run caps.
matchedTotal.title: Matched total

message.description: ERROR records only: what went wrong, in plain language.
message.title: Message

monitorOnlyNew.description: SUMMARY only: the run's monitorOnlyNew setting.
monitorOnlyNew.title: Monitor only new

note.description: SUMMARY only: what this run's records are and where they come from.
note.title: Note

patentTitle.description: PATENT only: the patent title as indexed by USPTO. Null only when the index carries no title.
patentTitle.title: Title

priorityDate.description: PATENT only: the earliest priority date (ISO date), where the publication claims priority. Absent on first filings that claim no priority — common for the newest applications.
priorityDate.title: Priority date

publicationDate.description: PATENT only: the publication date (ISO date) — the date the run window and the publishedSince cursor compare against.
publicationDate.title: Publication date

publicationNumber.description: PATENT only: the publication's stable number as published by the USPTO (e.g. "US12802069B1", "US20260370217A1") — the key only-new detection diffs against.
publicationNumber.title: Publication number

publishedSince.description: SUMMARY only, cursor runs only: the run's publishedSince cursor, exactly as given.
publishedSince.title: Published-since cursor

recordType.description: PATENT = one delivered patent publication (charged); SUMMARY = one run-summary record at the end of every run (never charged); ERROR = USPTO Patent Public Search could not be checked in this run (never charged).
recordType.title: Record type

resultsFetched.description: SUMMARY only: how many results the run actually read from the search API (pages are read newest-first until the caps are met or the searches are exhausted).
resultsFetched.title: Results fetched

searchUnits.description: SUMMARY only: how many searches the run executed (one per keyword query; one filter-only search when no keywords were given).
searchUnits.title: Search units

seededSilently.description: SUMMARY only: patents remembered without delivery because the run was a monitorOnlyNew first run against a fresh store.
seededSilently.title: Seeded silently

source.description: ERROR records only: the data source that could not be checked ("uspto-ppubs").
source.title: Source

sourceUrl.description: PATENT only: the publication's official PDF on USPTO's image server (image-ppubs.uspto.gov). A link shipped as data.
sourceUrl.title: Official USPTO PDF

stateExisted.description: SUMMARY only: true when the monitor store already held state from an earlier run.
stateExisted.title: State existed

stateStoreUsed.description: SUMMARY only: true when a monitor state store was opened and delta state applied.
stateStoreUsed.title: Monitor store used

stoppedByMaxCharge.description: SUMMARY only: true when delivery stopped at the run's maximum charge. Undelivered patents stay unseen; the next monitoring run delivers them.
stoppedByMaxCharge.title: Stopped by max charge

stoppedByResultCap.description: SUMMARY only: true when delivery stopped at the run's maximum-patents cap.
stoppedByResultCap.title: Stopped by result cap

streamComplete.description: SUMMARY only: true when the run read every search to its end (false when it stopped at a cap, the max charge, the timeout, or a source error).
streamComplete.title: Stream complete

truncatedByTimeout.description: SUMMARY only: true when delivery stopped early to stay inside the run timeout.
truncatedByTimeout.title: Truncated by timeout

type.description: PATENT only: "grant" for a granted US patent (source database USPAT), "application" for a published US patent application (US-PGPUB).
type.title: Publication type

unparsedSkipped.description: SUMMARY only: results skipped because they carried no usable publication guid.
unparsedSkipped.title: Skipped (unparsable)

windowEnd.description: SUMMARY only: the last publication date of the run's window (ISO date).
windowEnd.title: Window end

windowStart.description: SUMMARY only: the first publication date of the run's window (ISO date).
windowStart.title: Window start

patents.description: One row per delivered patent publication, plus one SUMMARY row per run and an ERROR row when the source could not be checked.
patents.title: Patents
